title: Nine Minutes on the Step
subtitle: 昆虫与自然 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 昆虫与自然（自然生态·昆虫与观察）
meta: 主题语境：昆虫与自然（自然生态·昆虫与观察）　|　核心词汇：ant　|　正文 372 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 ant 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1965 my brother found ① an ant on the step and watched it for nine minutes, and my grandfather said that was the only useful thing anybody in the house had done that year. There was ② a colony of ants under the third flagstone from 1961 onwards, and it was the only thing in the garden that survived 1976; an ant, he said, is the only creature that works without being watched.

The ③ ant hill at the end of the yard was nine inches high and had taken four years, and he measured it every Sunday. Every ④ ant path in the garden led to the same place, and he said a path that everybody takes is a road, and my grandmother said roads are the only thing people are proud of that an ant has already built; an ant, she said, is the only engineer who never draws anything.

My uncle had ⑤ ants in his pants from 1968 onwards, by which my grandmother meant that he could not sit down, and she said the phrase was invented for him. The ⑥ ant, meaning the whole species and not the one on the step, has been on the earth nine hundred times as long as we have, and he said that is the only fact that has ever made him polite; every ant, he said, is doing the same work and none of them know it.

He was ⑦ as busy as an ant for forty-one years and left nothing, and my grandmother said that is because ants do not leave things. By 1974 the ⑧ ants had come into the kitchen, nine of them on the first day, and the sugar went into a tin, which she said was the only victory anybody in the house ever won; an ant, he said, never asks whether the work will finish.

The  ant I remember is the one on the step in 1965, which my brother watched for nine minutes and which nobody ever saw again. An  ant, my grandfather said in 1979, is the only living thing that has never once been told to hurry, and the only one that has never once needed to be; every ant in that garden was doing the same thing.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: D. n. 蚂蚁（作为物种；蚁类）
E. 固定搭配：a colony of ants 蚁群；一窝蚂蚁
F. 固定搭配：ants in one's pants 坐立不安；急于行动
G. 固定搭配：an ant hill 蚁丘；蚁冢
H. 固定搭配：as busy as an ant 像蚂蚁一样忙碌

items.q: found an ant on the step
a colony of ants under the third flagstone
The ant hill at the end of the yard
Every ant path in the garden
had ants in his pants from 1968
The ant, meaning the whole species
as busy as an ant for forty-one years
the ants had come into the kitchen

answers.why: ant 意为“蚂蚁”，1965 年弟弟在台阶上发现一只蚂蚁，看了九分钟。
a colony of ants 意为“蚁群、一窝蚂蚁”，从 1961 年起第三块石板下就有一窝蚂蚁。
an ant hill 意为“蚁丘、蚁冢”，院子尽头那座蚁丘高九英寸，长了四年。
ant 作定语，意为“蚂蚁的”，花园里每一条蚂蚁走的路都通向同一个地方。
ants in one's pants 意为“坐立不安、急于行动”，1968 年起叔叔总是坐不住，祖母说这个词就是为他造的。
ant 意为“蚁类、蚂蚁这一物种”，蚂蚁这个物种在地球上存在的时间是我们的九百倍。
as busy as an ant 意为“像蚂蚁一样忙碌”，他四十一年里像蚂蚁一样忙碌，却什么也没留下。
ants 意为“成群的蚂蚁”，1974 年蚂蚁进了厨房，第一天就有九只。

There was a colony of ants under the third flagstone from 1961 onwards.
The ant hill at the end of the yard was nine inches high and had taken four years.
My uncle had ants in his pants from 1968 onwards, and my grandmother said the phrase was invented for him.
The ant has been on the earth nine hundred times as long as we have.
He was as busy as an ant for forty-one years and left nothing.
